purpose: Submission-facing benchmark-dataset and rendered-repair-fidelity evidence. This record supplements, but does not replace, the 2026-09-21 canonical work-calibration evidence.

publicV21VisualQuality.interpretation: The 44 LOCAL results reproduce the independent FULL-after raster exactly at 8-bit RGB precision on the evaluated frozen views. The 16 fallback cases select FULL by construction and are not counted as evidence of local fidelity. These are repair-fidelity metrics for the evaluated representation, not reconstruction fidelity to source photographs.

trained3dgsVisualQuality.interpretation: All four trained-3DGS LOCAL selections are byte-identical to FULL-after on the frozen views; the fifth case selects FULL. This remains a five-case secondary representation check.

canonicalWorkHeadline.note: The 2026-09-22 graphics rerun recalibrated hardware work on its runner. Its fresh work scalar is not substituted for the frozen canonical work headline; the rerun is used to establish benchmark-view visual fidelity.
